intro: Glow Dhara Massage Powder is a traditional ayurvedic ubtan‑style blend designed to revive dull skin and reveal a brighter, more even look. Used as a gentle polish or paste, it smooths texture, supports hydration, and minimizes the look of pores for a fresh glow. Ideal for pre‑event self‑care or routine brightening, this multi‑use powder complements a simple skincare ritual; results vary by skin type and consistency.

li: Ayurvedic massage ubtan that helps brighten the complexion and promote an even skin tone.
Gently buffs away dullness for a smoother feel while supporting hydration and soft glow.
Helps reduce the appearance of pores and early signs of aging with regular use.
Versatile powder for face and body; can be used as a cleanser, polish, or paste mask.
Travel‑friendly 20 g jar with gold cap for hygienic storage and easy scooping.
Cleanse skin. Mix 1–2 spoons with rose water, milk, or plain water to form a smooth paste.
Massage on face/body in circular motions for 2–3 minutes; leave on 5–10 minutes; rinse.
Use 2–3 times weekly; follow with toner and moisturizer or face oil. Patch test first.
1 x Glow Dhara Massage Powder, 20 g jar
Most skin types seeking brightening and polishing care; sensitive skin should patch test.
External use only. Avoid eyes and broken skin. Discontinue if irritation occurs.
Cosmetic/ayurvedic skincare; no medical claims implied.
